release_notes.title: PlazCode works in your tabs and apps, easy app connections and a fresh look
release_notes.summary: Apps & servers that connect your creative apps for you, helper agents, a fresh look and an easy Linux install.
added: Blender in RobloxScript: models reach Studio at the right size, facing the right way, with colours.
When the AI works in a tab or desktop app, it glows in your theme colour, shows PlazCode's cursor and a live preview in the chat; moving your mouse takes over.
Ask PlazCode (Alt+P, or the bar button in AgentScript): a side chat that sees the tab or whole screen you share and can control it when you switch that on.
New Apps & servers page: connect Blender, Godot, Unity, Figma and Blockbench with a checklist that ticks itself off.
PlazCode adds its own helpers to Blender, Unity, Figma and Blockbench and removes them on disconnect. Blender can also run in the background with safe mode on.
Guided browser extension setup on every system: PlazCode opens the extensions page and shows the folder to load.

Linux: install with one line, curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stoveez/PlazCode/main/install-linux.sh | sh . It adds itself to your app menu and updates itself. Roblox Studio through Vinegar is experimental.
Helper agents: the AI can start up to two extra chats to work on parts of a task at once.
Several commands per reply: reads run together, changes run in order.
A fresh app look with grouped pages, smoother page changes, glow and a theme builder.
Mac: now opens on macOS 10.15 Catalina too. Memory search needs macOS 12; on Catalina, use Firefox.
A redesigned PlazCode bar, settings menu (tabs and search), toolbar popup and Ask PlazCode panel that match the app's look and follow its Feel settings.
fixed: Notion: commands right after a sentence run again instead of sticking on processing.
DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and similar sites: the startup check no longer fails. Kimi's command card now appears at startup instead of raw JSON.
Freebuff: the bar no longer gets stuck on "Starting" or "Freebuff is writing" after PlazCode is ready, and sits on the right chat box in Code and Chat mode.
Gemini: the command card lines up with the reply. The bar keeps its buttons on one row on narrower chat boxes.
Ask PlazCode's background chat window stays minimised while it opens.
Commands no longer wait on the link between the extension and the app.
AI sites' own console errors are no longer listed as PlazCode errors on the browser's extensions page.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.

github.summary: ***PlazCode can now work in your tabs and apps while you watch, plus easy app connections and a fresh look.***

sections.title: ✨ What's new
items: Ask PlazCode (Alt+P, or the bar button in AgentScript): a side chat that sees your tab or screen and can control it if you allow it.
When the AI works in a tab or app, it glows in your theme colour with PlazCode's cursor and a live preview in the chat. Move your mouse to take over.
Apps & servers: connect Blender, Godot, Unity, Figma and Blockbench with a checklist that ticks itself off. Guided extension setup too.
Blender works in RobloxScript too. Models reach Studio at the right size, facing the right way, with colours.
Linux: one-line install with automatic updates: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stoveez/PlazCode/main/install-linux.sh | sh (Studio via Vinegar: experimental)
A redesigned PlazCode bar, settings menu and toolbar popup that match the app.
Helper agents, several commands per reply, and Mac support from macOS 10.15 (memory search needs 12).

sections.title: 🛠️ What's fixed
items: Startup works again on Notion, DeepSeek, Qwen and Kimi (Kimi shows its command card).
Freebuff no longer sticks on "Starting" or "Freebuff is writing".
Gemini's command card lines up; the bar stays on one row.
Commands no longer wait on the link to the app.

sections.title: 🧪 What was checked
items: Automated tests on Windows, Mac and Linux. The Kimi/Freebuff fixes and tab control are not yet re-tried on the real sites. Report anything odd.
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before.

release_notes.title: Startup, sign-in and ChatGPT fixes
release_notes.summary: Fixes for ChatGPT, DeepSeek, startup and sign-in problems found since 1.24.30, plus a guest mode.
added: Guest mode: if a profile can't be created, "Use PlazCode as a guest" keeps your settings, skills and memory on this computer, separate from online profiles.
Safer file work: the AI can use paths inside your project and preview files read-only.
Memory notes are loaded only when they are relevant, and AI results use one standard shape.
Command batches use one call shape, and the AI is told which capabilities are granted.
improved: Windows startup errors now name the folder and the missing file, and the Mac check matches the real app layout.
Slow Blender scenes get more time, and long single-line edits are handled in safe pieces.
fixed: ChatGPT: startup no longer hangs on "Starting Up" or "Send paused", including in Work mode.
ChatGPT: typing freezes, false "sent" confirmations and lost tool results.
Leftover startup text no longer stays in the message box.
The screenshot pop-up no longer shows a black box.
DeepSeek: false startup warnings, stuck sends and broken line breaks.
Sign-up and log-in recover from busy or offline servers; saved logins stay usable.
Windows: false "program files changed" startup error, and Windows paths inside the project.
Blender: first-time setup on Windows.
Ox Alpha: Copy is no longer counted as a message sent.
The AI keeps working on your project after short follow-ups.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.

release_notes.title: Screenshots, approvals and update warnings
release_notes.summary: Improves screenshot display, remembers task approvals in Plan Mode, and makes mismatched app and extension versions clear.
improved: The desktop Updates page shows active browser extension versions. Known outdated versions stay red when a later check fails.
fixed: Screenshot previews render from image bytes instead of image URLs that AI sites can block. Unreadable image data shows an error.
Approve all for this task now applies to the same command in Plan Mode.
Creation previews explain missing app support, oversized requests and invalid responses instead of showing a JSON parsing error.
notes: Replacing only the EXE does not update an extension loaded from another folder. Use the full update and load the updated extension folder.
Real Studio captures and the reported creation-preview failure were not reproduced on the affected computer.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized.

release_notes.title: Fewer limit errors and lower usage
release_notes.summary: Fixes the "message exceeds your input limit" error that stopped Claude in the middle of normal work, and makes PlazCode use noticeably less of your AI plan.
improved: PlazCode uses less of your AI plan: the AI no longer has to look up each command before using it, Ultra mode no longer re-sends its whole skill pack with every request, and the extra reference PlazCode adds to a request is smaller.
When the AI saves a note to your vault, PlazCode no longer sends the whole vault summary straight back to it.
fixed: Claude (and other sites) stopped with "This message exceeds your 12000 character input limit" even after a normal prompt. The extra notes PlazCode adds now always fit your limit: they are shortened, or wait for the next message. Command results themselves are never cut.
notes: Your Input characters setting still works the same for everything you type.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized, as before. Your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
